_comment: RECONSTRUCTED FIXTURE of a historical failure mode, shaped for the explain-this-operation panel. It is not a captured run artifact. Provenance: Laguna-XS 2.1 bring-up in PR #404 (commit 369032982, feat(v8/laguna): bring up the quantized text runtime) and the compact MoE provider work in PR #422 (commit 71f11c08f); the concrete omitted-binding shape matches the repair recorded in commit 2063aa6b7 (fix(v8): restore Laguna and Nemotron compilation, branch fix/v8-laguna-nemotron-contracts), whose message states that Laguna omitted an exact attention-gate projection input and strict MLP metadata. The candidate list and rejection vocabulary mirror find_kernel() selection_trace entries in version/v8/scripts/build_ir_v8.py.
title: Laguna: attention-gate projection rejected by provider compatibility filtering

stages.detail: Circuit op attention_gate_projection (layer 0) was composed, but the circuit did not declare its projection input, so the resolver saw a binding request without a declared source stream.
Requested binding: attention_projection class, decode phase, weight=q4_k, activation=q8_0 (planned Q8 stream), fp32 output.
Every candidate provider was rejected by compatibility filtering; zero providers remained for the requested binding.

candidates.note: Candidate-only lifecycle at bring-up time: the softplus gate kernel was validated as observed, not production, so the explicit-selection filter refused it.
The generic head-major projection provider declares mixed_w_fp32_a storage; it does not cover the requested q4_k gate weight role, so dtype compatibility filtering rejected it.

docs.label: Kernel Maps - a real resolver trace
Codegen - when compilation fails, start here

guidance: Where to look: the circuit's projection_inputs / required binding for the gate projection in version/v8/circuits/laguna.json, then the candidate provider's selection status and quant roles in its kernel map JSON. The historical repair declared the missing attention-gate projection input in the circuit and promoted an exact provider; it did not patch the resolver. This panel does not propose an automatic fix.
